metadata.title: Injectivity and continuity of the intersection form in infinite type
metadata.abstract: We study two fundamental properties of the intersection pairing between geodesic currents on infinite-type surfaces which are classical in the finite-type closed setting: injectivity of the marked length spectrum and continuity of the intersection form. We show that geodesic currents on infinite-type surfaces of the first kind are determined by their intersection numbers with closed curves, extending Otal's marked length spectrum rigidity argument from finite-type to infinite-type surfaces. In contrast, we prove that the intersection pairing is not continuous in general for the natural topologies by constructing explicit counterexamples. We then prove sufficient criteria for continuity of intersection numbers for infinite-type surfaces.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 刚性推广与连续性反例
analysis.workSummary: 研究无限型曲面上测地流交配对的谱刚性及连续性，比较两类在有限型情形经典成立的性质。
techniques: 显式不连续反例与充分条件
analysis.breakthrough: 第一类无限型曲面上的测地流由其与闭曲线的交数决定；一般自然拓扑下交配对却不连续，另给出连续性的充分判据。
analysis.limitations: 单射性要求第一类曲面；连续性具有额外条件，不能由长度谱决定性直接推得。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者明确声明研究与写作的任何方面均未使用 AI 或 LLM；命中属于否认声明，没有正面使用披露。此记录不等于独立检测认证。

analysis.priorityReason: 刚性与连续性在无限型中的分离十分明确。
